_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::scalar_transport#1 — VELOCITYFIELD is OPTIONAL: 'zero' is its default, and a deck with the key deleted produces a bit-identical answer with no diagnostic anywhere. The omitted arm passes the same 1e-12 result test as the explicit one ('is CORRECT', abs(diff)=0), exits 0, and the substring 'velocit' appears zero times in its whole log (OMITTED_MENTIONS_VELOCITY=0). Both strings an earlier version of this entry quoted are absent (CLAIMED_VELOCITY_FIELD_NOT_FOUND=0, CLAIMED_VELNP_UNINITIALIZED=0). A third arm keeps the silence from being an absence of checking: VELOCITYFIELD: 'function' with no VELFUNCNO does draw an error, 'Function with index -1 (i.e. input FUNCT-1) not available.' from core/utils/src/functions/4C_utils_function_manager.hpp. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C 2026.2.0-dev (git 89519cf) at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C.
expect_in_output: Function with index -1 (i.e. input FUNCT-1) not available.

_mutation.note: remove the pathology: put VELOCITYFIELD back in the second arm. There is then no omission under test, OMITTED_DECK_HAS_VELOCITYFIELD becomes 1 and the fixture must go red.
remove the control: give the bogus arm a working velocity setting. 4C then has nothing to object to, EXIT_BOGUS becomes 0 and the function-manager diagnostic disappears, so the fixture must go red.
